purpose: Bridge index consolidating multi-stage collaboration files for pyMatrix front-end Nuxt app and Python backend

stagePipeline.overview: The bridge is delivered through three stages to keep coordination artifacts concise and easier to review.

stages.title: Core Collaboration Bridge
focus: Full bi-directional coordination between Nuxt frontend modules and Python backend services
Feature completion tracking: 61/61 verified with centralization compliance
Lock information and participant responsibilities for continuous delivery

stages.title: Audio Feature Integration
focus: sndcpy audio streaming feature (F062) implementation details
Frontend Vue components, composables, Pinia store, and backend API tasks
Validation checklist covering install/start/stop flow and log streaming

stages.title: Patch Update V2
focus: Implementation tracking document references and codebase statistics
Follow-up tasks and risk notes for post-verification hardening

usage.read: Consult individual stage files for full JSON payloads and detailed task matrices.
usage.update: Add or update stages by appending to stagePipeline.stages and writing corresponding files under docs/bridge_with_nuxt_pyMatrix.
usage.notes: This index replaces the former monolithic AI_COLLABORATION_BRIDGE.json to avoid oversized single-file updates.
